codeReview.summary: The feature closes several text fallback gaps, but it still misses a contract-critical native-path clipping case: fully clipped native text can allocate atlas entries before the clip test rejects the glyphs. That means VAL-TEXT-010 is not fully satisfied for non-private-use text on the native glyph path.

issues.description: In `appendNativeTextGlyphs`, `NativeGlyphAtlas.shared.glyph(...)` runs before the glyph's clipped bounds are checked. For fully off-clip native text, this still rasterizes/inserts glyphs into the native atlas, marks the atlas dirty, and can attach `scene.glyphAtlas` even though no glyph primitive is emitted. That violates VAL-TEXT-010's requirement that fully clipped text stay atlas-silent for the pass.
